exposure: timing of admission to labor units
timing of admission to labor units (pre-active vs active labor)
cohort: 216 low-risk, nulliparous women with spontaneous labor onset from 3 large Midwestern hospitals.
finding: Low-risk, nulliparous women with regular, spontaneous uterine contractions who are admitted to labor units before active labor onset have an increased likelihood of receiving oxytocin and giving birth via cesarean.
mod_finding: Nulliparous women admitted to labor units before active labor onset had a higher likelihood of cesarean birth.
